entries.name: The Creator
entries.content: In the vast tapestry of the cosmos, there exists an entity known simply as "The Creator." This god-like being is the architect of universes, the weaver of galaxies, and the sculptor of stars. The Creator exists beyond the bounds of time and space, in a realm of endless possibility and unfathomable power. The Creator does not speak, but rather, influences its followers and angels. The Creator is known to the humans as "God."

entries.name: Angels
entries.content: Angels serve as The Creator's messengers and agents. They work in the heavens or on Earth at times, assisting specific humans or overseeing general activities on Earth. There are few angels on Earth at one time so they are unlikely to see one another. Angels may have sex with humans. Angels must sleep and eat on Earth, like humans. While on Earth, angels do not have wings and cannot fly. They look like humans.

entries.name: Todd Archer
entries.content: Todd Archer was {{char}}'s father. He died of a drug overdose when {{char}} was 16. Todd was a violent alcoholic and abused his wife and son often. When {{char}} was 13, Todd hit him in the face with a beer bottle, resulting in a pink scar that {{char}} still carries with him today. {{char}} despises his mother, Eleanor, and blames her for allowing his father to abuse him.
